parameters.help_en:
The ID of the blacklist policy.

For information about how to obtain the ID of a blacklist policy, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457257.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略的ID。

关于如何获取报警黑名单策略的ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457257.html
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the blacklist policy
parameters.help_zh: 报警黑名单策略的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The namespace of the cloud service.

For more information about the namespaces of cloud services, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的数据命名空间。

关于云产品的命名空间，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The category of the cloud service. For example, ApsaraDB for Redis supports the standard architecture, the cluster architecture, and the read/write splitting architecture. In this case, the valid values of this parameter for ApsaraDB for Redis include `kvstore_standard`, `kvstore_sharding`, and `kvstore_splitrw`
parameters.help_zh: 云产品分类。例如：Redis有`kvstore_standard`（标准版）、`kvstore_sharding`（集群版）和`kvstore_splitrw`（读写分离版）等
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The effective scope of the blacklist policy. Valid values:

- USER: The blacklist policy takes effect only within the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- GROUP (default): The blacklist policy takes effect only within the specified application group. For information about how to obtain the ID of an application group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略的生效范围。取值：

- USER：报警黑名单策略仅在当前阿里云账号中生效。

- GROUP（默认值）：报警黑名单策略在指定应用分组中生效，您需要选择指定应用分组。
  关于如何获取应用分组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.name: scope_type

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the application groups.

> This parameter is required only when `ScopeType` is set to `GROUP`
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组ID列表。

> 仅当`ScopeType`为`GROUP`时，需要设置该参数
parameters.name: scope_value

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp when the blacklist policy starts to take effect.

Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略生效的开始时间戳。

单位：毫秒
parameters.name: enable_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp when the blacklist policy expires.

Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略生效的结束时间戳。

单位：毫秒
parameters.name: enable_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time range within which the blacklist policy is effective. Take note of the following information:

- If you do not configure this parameter, the blacklist policy is permanently effective.

- If you configure this parameter, the blacklist policy is effective only within the specified time range. Examples:

  - `03:00-04:59`: The blacklist policy is effective from 03:00 to 05:00 local time. 05:00 local time is excluded.

  - `03:00-04:59 UTC+0700`: The blacklist policy is effective from 03:00 to 05:00 (UTC+7). 05:00 (UTC+7) is excluded
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略的生效时间范围。是否设置该参数的含义如下：

- 如果您未设置该参数，则报警黑名单策略永久有效。

- 如果您已设置该参数，则黑名单策略仅在指定的时间范围内有效。该参数有以下两种格式示例：
    - `03:00-04:59`：本地时间凌晨3点到凌晨5点（不包含05:00）报警黑名单策略有效。
    - `03:00-04:59 UTC+0700`：东7区时间凌晨3点到凌晨5点（不包含05:00）报警黑名单策略有效
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances that belong to the specified cloud service
parameters.help_zh: 报警黑名单策略中指定云服务的实例列表
parameters.name: instances

element_fields.help_en:
The name of the metric.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
element_fields.help_zh:
监控指标名称。

N的取值范围：1~10
element_fields.name: metric_name

element_fields.help_en:
The extended dimension of the instance. For example, `{"device":"C:"}` specifies that the blacklist policy is applied to all C disks of the specified Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
element_fields.help_zh:
实例的扩展维度信息。例如：`{"device":"C:"}`，表示对云服务器ECS实例下的所有C盘应用黑名单策略。

N的取值范围：1~10
element_fields.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The metrics of the instance.

- If you do not configure this parameter, the blacklist policy applies to all metrics of the specified cloud service.

- If you configure this parameter, the blacklist policy applies only to the current metric
parameters.help_zh:
实例中的监控指标。

- 如果您未设置该参数，则报警黑名单策略应用于指定云服务下的所有监控指标。

- 如果您已设置该参数，则黑名单策略仅应用于当前监控指标
parameters.name: metrics
